text:
alex: Ran quantized bringup for simhash embedding variant on c4-holdout. recall@1 down ~4.5% vs fp16 baseline. Any ideas?

sam: Oof. Is this int8 per-tensor or per-channel?

alex: Per-tensor symmetric, using ONNX export -> dynamic quant. Run id: https://runs.internal/r/2334

maria: Can you paste the eval table snippet?

alex: ```
model,precision,recall@1,recall@5,avg_sim,silhouette
simhash-int8,INT8,0.743,0.912,0.32,0.11
simhash-fp16,FP16,0.789,0.927,0.36,0.18
``` 

jing: Silhouette drop is suspicious. Could be scale clipping in quantization. Which quant library?

alex: Using our qconfigs/v1 -> static range estimated from calibration set (10k samples). No per-channel.

corey: Try per-channel or pow2 scaling. Also check embedding norm distribution shift. Did you L2-normalize after quant?

alex: Not before quant, we normalize afterwards. Rerunning with pre-quant L2.

eval-bot: Automated sanity: kmeans 50 clusters drift: ARI 0.62 -> 0.49, median cosine shift 0.018

maria: ARI drop matches recall loss. Possible solution: fake quant during training or per-channel quant.

sam: Quick test: run int8 per-channel and int8 per-tensor with 8-bit symmetric+minmax. Also run calibration with percentile 99.9.

alex: Running per-channel now. ETA ~35m. Will post diffs.

(35m later)

alex: Update: per-channel INT8 improved recall@1 to 0.779 (vs 0.789 fp16), recall@5 0.925. Silhouette 0.17. Looks much closer. Keeping this as default for simhash.

jing: Nice. Let's add a note in the onboarding doc: simhash prefers per-channel quant and pre-quant L2 norm. I'll open a PR.

maria: Also add a small eval checklist: calibration size, percentiles, cluster ARI, median cosine shift.

corey: Can we add a quick smoke in CI to catch >2% recall@1 regressions on holdout? :eyes: 

alex: Yeah I'll wire a nightly run and alert policy. Thanks all :thumbsup:
